name: sannr API audit

on:

  pull_request:
  schedule:

  contents: read

jobs:
  report:
    name: sannr CI report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out source for sannr
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node for sannr
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install sannr from the vendored engine
        run: npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --offline --no-save "./vendor/sannr-ci.tgz"

        if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        run: ./node_modules/.bin/sannr audit . --ci --report-only --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" --no-execute
      - name: sannr weekly freshness report
        if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
        run: ./node_modules/.bin/sannr audit . --ci --report-only --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" --no-execute
